title: Expert part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a rectangular loop. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.1453), followed by the third line from (0.75, 0.1453) to (0.0, 0.1453), and finally the fourth line from (0.0, 0.1453) back to the origin. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by applying the same Euler angles and translation vector used initially. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0058 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting expert part has a length of 0.7500000000000001 units, a width of 0.14534883720930233 units, and a height of 0.005813953488372094 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1453) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1453) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0058)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
